meta.target: T2 receiver simulator: QPSK/16-QAM mapper + block size of rate-1/2 terminated CC (133,171)_8, nu=6
meta.written_from: spec in the delegation message + textbook QAM facts; implementation code NOT read

spec.code: rate 1/2, terminated, generators (133,171)_8, memory nu=6 -> 2(K+6) coded bits
spec.Ns: N_t (T - T_p) = 4 * (16 - 4) = 48 data symbols per block
spec.qam16: Re, Im in {-3,-1,+1,+3}/sqrt(10), per-axis 2-bit Gray, bit-label convention free

tolerance.note: float64_abs for complex128 implementations (01_RULES 9.3 says receiver runs complex128). float32_abs only if the mapper is complex64; it must then be reported as float32.

calc: info bits per data symbol K/Ns: 42/48 = 0.875, 90/48 = 1.875
cases.tol: exact (integers); K_over_Ns and rate are exact binary fractions

calc: points = scale*(a + j b), a,b in {-3,-1,1,3}, scale = 1/sqrt(10) = sqrt(3/(2(M-1))) with M=16
mean energy: per axis mean of a^2 over {-3,-1,1,3} = (9+1+1+9)/4 = 5; Re+Im = 10; times scale^2 = 1/10 -> 1 exactly
d_min = level step 2 * scale = 2/sqrt(10) = 0.6324555320336759; d_min^2 = 0.4
Es per coded bit = Es/m = 1/4 = 0.25
peak energy 1.8, PAPR = 1.8 = 2.5527 dB
per-axis hard-decision thresholds: 0 and +-2/sqrt(10) = +-0.6324555320336759
cases.tol: float64_abs on energies/distances; point set: every point within float64_abs of a distinct grid point

cases.what: Gray property and axis separation, labelling-convention free
calc: nearest pairs on a 4x4 grid: 4 rows*3 + 4 cols*3 = 24; equivalently (4*2+8*3+4*4)/2 = 24
Gray: all 24 nearest pairs have label Hamming distance exactly 1 (violations = 0)
axis separation: 2 bit positions are functions of the Re level only, the other 2 of the Im level only

1-D: four distinct 2-bit labels with adjacent levels 1 bit apart walk the 4-cycle 00-01-11-10, so levels 3 apart are also 1 bit apart and levels 2 apart are 2 bits apart: g(|d|) = [0,1,2,1] for |d| = 0,1,2,3
full Hamming matrix: H(p,q) = g(|dr|) + g(|di|) for all 256 ordered pairs, where dr, di are level-index differences
Hamming histogram over 120 unordered pairs: H=1: 32 (24 at d_min + 8 at 3*d_min, the row/column end pairs), H=2: 48, H=3: 32, H=4: 8

brute force (golden_qam16.enumerate_gray_4x4): the 4x4 grid has exactly 384 Gray labellings = 6 (choice of Re bit pair) * 8 * 8 (1-D Gray per axis) = |Aut(Q4)| = 2^4*4!; all 384 are axis separated and satisfy the H formula, so for 16-QAM axis separation and H follow from nearest-neighbour Gray + bijection

cases.what: noiseless and near-noiseless hard decision through the implementation's own modulate/hard_demod
cases.input: bits = labels 0..M-1 written MSB first and concatenated (64 bits for 16-QAM, 8 for QPSK); the bit order is whatever the implementation consumes, the checks do not care
calc: (a) noiseless: hard_demod(modulate(bits)) == bits, and the M output symbols form the grid of C2/C5 and pass C3 (check_constellation on the implementation's own table)
(b) y = s + 0.99*(d_min/2)*u, u in {1, j, -1, -j, 1+j, 1-j, -1+j, -1-j}: decision region of every point contains the open square of half-width d_min/2, so the label is unchanged
(c) y = s_a + 0.51*(s_b - s_a) for every ordered nearest pair (a,b): decided label = label of b, which is exactly 1 bit away from label of a
(d) outer points pushed 5*d_min outward perpendicular to their edge (corners diagonally), and corners scaled by 10: outer regions are unbounded, label unchanged
exact ties at d_min/2 are NOT tested (tie-break is implementation-defined)
count_derivation: 16-QAM: inside = 16*8 = 128; cross = 2*24 ordered pairs = 48; outward = 12 non-inner points + 4 corners*10 = 16

calc: points (+-1 +- j)/sqrt(2); |s|^2 = 2/2 = 1 for every point -> mean 1
Es per coded bit = 1/2
each point has 2 nearest neighbours (all are corners), 4 nearest pairs, all 1 bit apart; diagonal pair 2 bits apart; 1 bit on Re, 1 bit on Im; g_1d = [0,1]

cases.calc: corner has one neighbour per axis inward; edge has 2 along the edge + 1 inward; inner has 4. Count of each class: 4 corners, 4*(4-2)=8 edges, (4-2)^2=4 inner

cases.what: boundary: QPSK and 16-QAM have the same mean symbol energy
cases.calc: QPSK: 2/2 = 1; 16-QAM: 10/10 = 1 (C2). Same Es, so the same SNR means the same Es/N0 for both; Es per coded bit differs (1/2 vs 1/4)

cases.what: boundary and wrong-K detection for check_K

rows.why: (96-6)/2: tail counted as 6 coded bits instead of 12

cases.what: boundary: decision near region edges and outside the grid (run through check_roundtrip, case C4 b-d)
inputs the checks must reject (shows the checks have teeth)

natural_binary.input: 16-QAM grid, label = 4*r + i with r,i = level index 0..3 (natural binary per axis, not Gray)
calc: per axis labels 00,01,10,11: pair (1,2) is 2 bits apart -> 1 violation per row and per column -> 4 + 4 = 8
1-D error e = H_nat - g: +1 for {1,2},{0,3}; -1 for {0,2},{1,3}; 0 for the 4 diagonal and {0,1},{2,3}. Ordered 1-D pairs: e=0: 8, e=+1: 4, e=-1: 4
2-D entry matches iff e_r + e_i = 0: 8*8 + 4*4 + 4*4 = 96 of 256 -> mismatches = 160

bad_demod_thresholds.input: hard demod using thresholds 0, +-2 (unnormalised grid) on normalised symbols
bad_demod_thresholds.calc: |Re|,|Im| <= 3/sqrt(10) < 2, so outer levels are decided as inner: every point with an outer coordinate (16 - 4 inner = 12) is wrong
